posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
There is a link there under the 'Trending at' sectionon the top of the kicktraq page you should read.

 

Trending is just a straight exposition of previous days. It is -not- predictive in any manner, and very unlikely to be accurate.  It simply is a 'If you are lucky enough to continue exactly as you have been doing up to this point'

 

The predictive cone on the other hand takes into account the general curve and an allowance for varriance. If you were watching it you'll have noticed that up till the announcement of Vengeance and the huge jump we had on friday, the cone was getting smaller and smaller as it was getting a more accurate picture of where we were heading. That jump has thrown a loop into the prediction plans, as will have this second jump.... Id say unless some big time surge of population hits i n the last day we're still heading for the lower end of the projection scale, but who knows? Its hard to predict these things. Depends a lot on Word of Mouth and what people want and are interested in.

posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
In fact, look at this link

 

http://blog.kicktraq.com/the-state-of-projections/

 

 

which talks about Projections and how they are used. Amusingly it has Infernal Relics as its frist example - which is nice bcause it shows us the projection trend over the state of the project as acomparaison - IR didnt have the jumps were getting with the announce of Vengeance. youll notice on the vengenance anouncement days, there was a massive jump - 10k  yesterday but only 55 new backers? 8k the first day but only 40 new backers? Before we were doing 30-40 backers at 2kish. Its interesting to see, which means a majority of that money is certainly coming from people upping to include Vengeance.

 

we also see that we have over 1500 today alone at 8am EST (i believe Kicktraq is on EST or Central time) and only 9 new backers. The amount of new backers coming to the project per day isnt changing (though perhaps more of them are pledging /more/ than an average of 50-75 dollars - that would be likely expansion+Shipping+couple of alacart items before - and now including vengeance in their pledges (putting around 100dollar pledge or so) 

 

Which can then be taken that the only way we are going to hit 150k is ... A) Pray for a jump at the end (Common) as people waiting get in at the last minute, and we all work to get friends who havent pledged to pledge now or b) we who have already pledged for Shattered timelines, up our pledges for Vengeance.

 

Finally - http://www.kickstarter.com/blog/trends-in-pricing-and-duration

there is a very awsome chart in that post that shows a very common trend - last day or 2 is /very/ commonly higher for a successfully funded project. Now that doesnt say if those projects used in that graph were already funded before the end day, or if they needed a final push to -get- funded. But still, i would hazard a guess that there is usually a bump in the last few days, given that a lot of people will go 'Crap i wanted to fund that, but put it off to make sure I had the money!' and pledge.

 

So where am i going with this? (besides being a pretend number geek with no actual knowledge of economics, statistics, or anything else related to this kind of information?)


Go get your friends to pledge and if you want vengeance in 2013 instead of 2014, then pledge now!
